notes: Crisp now does what you ask, in the direction you ask. “Reduce the warmth” cools the picture, “boost the highlights” grades them, “increase the grain” adds grain, and “lower the resolution”, “downscale it” or “make it 720p” really bring the picture down a size and shrink the file with it. Telling Crisp not to do something — “don’t remove the audio” — is always a no. “Remove the compression artifacts” or “it looks blocky” cleans up blocky video before Enhance. New bass and treble controls: say “more bass” or “less treble”, or pick them from the Audio menu. Cancel now stops a render even when the GPU has stopped responding, Enhance at 4× keeps your clip’s colours, and editing an HD clip that had no colour labels no longer shifts its colours. Asking to remove a watermark gets a straight answer, and “Try again” on a Pro-only job opens the unlock window.
